Emma (AE): Starting check-in for ZephyrBank POC swap — main asks: API parity, measurable output diffs, 6mo commit + burst pricing, and security questionnaire. Logging action items here.
Devin (Solutions): I have a harness ready but need their canonical prompts + sample outputs. Will run baseline vs our model.
Kai (Infra Eng): I'll provision a small dedicated pool and can front it with a lightweight compatibility proxy. Two infra blockers Zen flagged: SAML SSO + customer KMS wrapping; plus auditable generation logs.
Priya (Security): Security needs: data residency options, retention windows, audit log format (parquet preferred), KMS rotation cadence. They want completed questionnaire by Monday EOD.
Ashley (Platform): Note: their current vendor returns 429 with `retry_after_ms`. Our scale-up path can return 503. Proposal: proxy maps 503 -> `Retry-After` header for compatibility.
sec-bot: created ticket ZP-501 and attached questionnaire.
Devin (Solutions): Quick parity run: token variance ~10-14%. Most diffs due to tokenization differences and whitespace handling. Recommendation: normalize (trim + NFKC) before tokenizing.
Kai (Infra Eng): Proxy mapping sketch: map `promptList` -> `input` and translate error headers. Will drop gist link when ready.
Emma (AE): Pricing ask: they expect ~2M reqs/mo. Confirm whether retries and partials bill normally. Sales needs three-tier commit quote.
Devin (Solutions): Ballpark tokens: avg 85/request -> ~170M tokens/month. With prefix caching we could save ~25%. I'll prepare pessimistic/expected/optimistic scenarios.
Priya (Security): I'll fill the questionnaire and upload KMS diagram + SOC2 attestation.
legal-bot: flagged DPA and indemnity clause for review.
Emma (AE): Plan: (1) Devin runs two parity passes and posts diffs, (2) Kai stands up pool + proxy, (3) Priya finalizes security answers, (4) Sales drafts committed pricing. Quick sync tomorrow 09:00 PT. All good? :thumbsup:
